derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);
def: to furnish aside, i.e. get ready

occurrences.text: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
